# Chemistry Learner

> > Educational chemistry resource covering chemical elements, compounds, reactions, and fundamental concepts across inorganic, organic, and physical chemistry.

Chemistry Learner provides comprehensive reference materials and tutorials on chemical formulas, properties, reactions, and periodic table elements. The site covers topics from basic molecular structures and formal charge calculations to specialized reactions like Finkelstein and haloform mechanisms, serving students and chemistry enthusiasts.

## Key Topics

- Chemical formulas and properties
- Periodic table elements
- Inorganic chemistry compounds
- Organic chemistry reactions
- Physical chemistry concepts
- Molecular structure and bonding
- Formal charge calculations
- Ionic compounds
- Transition metals
- Noble gases
- Safety data and toxicity
- Material properties
- Thermodynamics
- Chemical equilibrium
- Radioactive isotopes

## Chemical Elements

- [Xenon Definition, Facts, Symbol, Discovery, Properties, Uses](https://www.chemistrylearner.com/xenon.html): Noble gas xenon (Xe): element 54 properties and compounds like XeF4
- [Manganese Facts, Symbol, Discovery, Properties, Everyday Uses](https://www.chemistrylearner.com/manganese.html): Transition metal manganese (Mn): properties, functions, and toxicity
- [Platinum Facts, Symbol, Discovery, Properties, Uses](https://www.chemistrylearner.com/platinum.html): Platinum (Pt) element reference: properties, melting point, and uses
- [Promethium Facts, Symbol, Discovery, Properties, Uses](https://www.chemistrylearner.com/promethium.html): Radioactive lanthanide promethium (element 61): properties and uses
- [Radium-226 - Chemistry Learner](https://www.chemistrylearner.com/radium-226.html): Radium-226 isotope data: half-life, alpha decay, medical/industrial uses

## Physical Chemistry Concepts

- [Gibbs' Phase Rule: Definition, Significance, and Derivation](https://www.chemistrylearner.com/gibbs-phase-rule.html): Thermodynamics guide explaining Gibbs' Phase Rule with derivation examples
- [Solvation: Definition, Process, and Examples](https://www.chemistrylearner.com/solvation.html): Physical chemistry guide to solvation process and hydration examples
- [Dynamic Equilibrium: Definition and Examples](https://www.chemistrylearner.com/dynamic-equilibrium.html): Chemical equilibrium tutorial explaining reversible reactions concept
- [Elastomer: Definition, Types, Properties, Examples and Uses](https://www.chemistrylearner.com/elastomer.html): Polymer chemistry guide covering elastomer types and rubber materials

## Organic Chemistry Reactions

- [Finkelstein Reaction: Definition, Examples and Mechanism](https://www.chemistrylearner.com/finkelstein-reaction.html): Organic chemistry guide to Finkelstein SN2 halogen exchange reaction
- [Haloform Reaction: Definition, Examples, and Mechanism](https://www.chemistrylearner.com/haloform-reaction.html): Organic chemistry guide to haloform reaction with methyl ketones

## Molecular Structure and Formal Charge

- [Formal Charge of Carbon Monoxide (CO)](https://www.chemistrylearner.com/formal-charge-of-co.html): Tutorial on calculating formal charge for CO with Lewis structure
- [Formal Charge of Nitrate (NO3-)](https://www.chemistrylearner.com/formal-charge-of-no3.html): Tutorial on calculating formal charge for nitrate ion structure

## Inorganic Compounds

- [Lithium Hydride Facts, Formula, Properties, Uses, Safety Data](https://www.chemistrylearner.com/lithium-hydride.html): LiH compound reference: formula, properties, safety data, and uses
- [Magnesium Fluoride Facts, Formula, Properties, Uses](https://www.chemistrylearner.com/magnesium-fluoride.html): MgF2 ionic compound reference: synthesis, solubility, and applications
- [Potassium Bromate Facts, Formula, Properties, Uses](https://www.chemistrylearner.com/potassium-bromate.html): KBrO3 oxidizing agent: formula, properties, toxicity, and applications
- [Calcium Nitrate Facts, Formula, Properties, Uses, Safety Data](https://www.chemistrylearner.com/calcium-nitrate.html): Norwegian saltpeter reference: structure, synthesis, and safety data
- [Sulfurous Acid - Chemical Formula, Physical Properties, Uses and Effects](https://www.chemistrylearner.com/sulfurous-acid.html): H2SO3 weak acid reference: formula, properties, and chemical effects

## Specialized Materials and Compounds

- [Cerrosafe Properties, Uses, Precautions](https://www.chemistrylearner.com/cerrosafe.html): Bismuth-based low-melting alloy properties and chamber casting uses
- [Amifostine Formula, Properties, Uses, Side Effects](https://www.chemistrylearner.com/amifostine.html): Cytoprotective drug amifostine: formula, properties, and side effects
